name: 44614 · Canal Fulton, OH
findings: ZIP 44614 (Canal Fulton) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44614 (Canal Fulton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44614 (Canal Fulton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
